name: Juice JuiceStaking unbounded stake multiplier
summary: JuiceStaking.stake accepted an unbounded caller-supplied stakingWeek, and pendingReward multiplied accrued rewards by 9% for every week beyond the first. The attacker opened three positions with stakingWeek 3,000,000,000 and drained the reward balance through harvest.
notes: JuiceStaking is direct immutable code. Its runtime hash is identical at deployment and immediately before the first malicious stake.

Three harvests transferred exactly 1,303,812.167090353881679192 JUICE from JuiceStaking to the attack helper. The helper combined those rewards with 1,363.521112903506075187 JUICE left from its attacker-funded purchase, then sold all 1,305,175.688203257387754379 JUICE in five transactions for exactly 53.927126190113628957 ETH. Applying that realized average rate only to the reward tokens, then valuing ETH at the nearest preceding DefiLlama observation, gives $211,733.74654325828. The 1,240 JUICE staked from the same purchase remains attacker-supplied input and is excluded.
